messages.content: Can you explain machine learning like I'm five?

Sure! Imagine you have a puppy and you want to teach it to recognize cats. Every time it correctly points at a cat, you give it a treat. Over many tries, the puppy gets better and better. Machine learning is similar — we show a computer thousands of examples and reward it when it gets things right, until it learns the pattern.
